problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}4 & -6 & 7 \\ -8 & 10 & -10 \\ 4 & 6 & -9\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & \boxed{} & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}4 & -6 & 7 \\ 0 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry ${l}_{32}$ in the matrix $L?$

feedback.problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 1 & -2 & 0 \\ 2 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ \boxed{} & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry ${l}_{31}$ in the matrix $L?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We want to make $0$ at the position ${a}_{31}$ using Gaussian elimination. To do this, we take the $3$rd row of $A,$ and we add the $1$st row of $A$ multiplied by $-2:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 1 & -2 & 0 \\ 2 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 1 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The entry ${l}_{31}$ of the matrix $L$ is the factor next to ${R}_{1},$ taken with the opposite sign:

$$
{l}_{31}=-(-2)=2.
$$
